comments.headline: Dimensioned floor plans and unit details absent
comments.summary: No architectural floor plans are submitted showing unit layouts, dimensions, or area breakdowns by floor level. Only site plan and building footprints are provided.
comments.attn: Architectural drawings from Danze & Davis Architects required before plan review completion.

details.text: Dimensioned floor plans for 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom townhome unit types not provided in submission.

runComments.comment: Dimensioned floor plans showing layouts and dimensions for each distinct unit type (2-bedroom and 3-bedroom townhomes) are not provided in the site plan submission. Architectural drawings with unit-level floor plan details are not included in the available documentation and cannot be verified.

Dimensioned floor plans showing unit layouts and dimensions are not provided for the two distinct unit types (2-bedroom and 3-bedroom townhomes). Site plan shows only building footprints and unit numbers without any interior floor plan details.

The submitted site plan contains no architectural floor plans. Only civil/site engineering sheets (39 sheets total) are provided, which do not show dimensioned floor plans for each distinct unit type. Cannot verify compliance without submission of dimensioned architectural plans for each unit type.

details.text: Floor area data table with square footage breakdown by floor (1st, 2nd, 3rd, garage, covered porch, patio) not provided for multi-story units.

runComments.comment: Floor area data table showing square footage breakdown by floor level (1st floor, 2nd floor, 3rd floor, garage area, covered porches, patios) is not provided for the multi-story townhome unit types. The Building Data Table shows total gross floor area per building but not the SF distribution across floor levels for each unit type.
Floor area data table showing SF breakdown by floor (1st floor, 2nd floor, garage area, covered porch, patio) is not provided for the multi-story townhome units or condominium units.

No floor area data table is provided showing square footage breakdown by floor (1st floor, 2nd floor, garage, covered porch, patio) for the multi-story unit types. Buildings with up to 3 stories are proposed, but floor area by story is not documented in available plans.

details.text: Mail kiosk shown on site plan but not dimensioned with width and depth measurements.

runComments.comment: Mail kiosk is shown on the site plan but is not dimensioned with width and depth dimensions. Provide floor plan dimensions (length and width) for the mail kiosk on the site plan or on a separate detail sheet.

comments.headline: Code-required designations missing from plans
comments.summary: Plans lack fire wall separation ratings, accessibility unit type designations, public amenity accessibility features, building systems documentation, and elevator requirement analysis required by IBC and LDC.
comments.crossDep: Fire Department (fire wall rating verification); ADA Program (accessibility unit designations and accessible route documentation)
comments.attn: Elevator requirement depends on unit distribution by floor level. Subchapter E shower/locker facilities applicability unclear — confirm if mixed-use component applies to this straight residential project.

details.text: Fire wall separation ratings (1-hour or 2-hour) not noted on plans for wall separations between individual townhome units in all eight buildings.

runComments.comment: Townhome dwelling unit fire wall separation requirements (1-hour or 2-hour ratings) are not noted on the cover sheet, site plan, or floor plans. Provide fire wall rating designations for wall separations between individual townhome units per applicable building code requirements.

Fire wall separation rating (1-hour or 2-hour) between townhome units is not noted on the cover sheet or floor plans. This information is required for townhome designs to demonstrate fire-rated separation between adjacent dwelling units.

Project description identifies 39 townhome units, but no architectural floor plans are provided showing townhome fire wall separation ratings (1-hour or 2-hour). Fire wall separation requirements cannot be verified without submission of building elevations or floor plans with fire-rated wall designations.

details.text: Fully accessible, Type A adaptable, and Type B adaptable dwelling unit designations not identified on site plan, floor plans, or cover sheet per IBC §§ 1104.2, 1107.6.

runComments.comment: Fully accessible, Type A adaptable, and Type B adaptable dwelling unit designations are not identified on site plan, floor plans, garage plans, or cover sheet. Residential units must be designated by accessibility type per IBC §§ 1104.2 and 1107.6. Provide unit designations on floor plans, site plan, and cover sheet identifying which units meet fully accessible, Type A, or Type B adaptable requirements.

Fully accessible, Type A, and Type B adaptable dwelling units are not designated on the site plan, floor plans, or cover sheet. Residential buildings are required to identify which units meet these accessibility standards per the adopted 2024 International Building Code.

No architectural floor plans, garage plans, or cover sheet notes are provided showing required accessibility designations: fully accessible, Type A, and Type B adaptable dwelling units. Residential buildings with 39 units require these designations per IBC accessibility standards; submission of architectural plans is required to verify compliance.

details.text: Public accommodations (leasing office, fitness center) and amenities (courtyards, pools, BBQ areas) and required accessible routes not clearly identified or marked on site and floor plans.

runComments.comment: Public accommodations (leasing offices, fitness centers) and public amenities (courtyards, pools, BBQ areas) are not clearly identified on plans for accessibility documentation. While site plan shows common open space (4,960 sf) and a BBQ pit, their accessibility features and required accessible routes are not explicitly marked for review. Clarify location and type of all public amenities and shared facilities with accessibility markings on site and floor plans.

details.text: Subchapter E Table B shower and locker facilities requirement applicability not documented. If elected, minimum 2 facilities required for 83,986 sf GFA but none shown on plans.

runComments.comment: Site plan indicates project is subject to Subchapter E of the Land Development Code. However, documentation showing whether the shower and locker facilities Table B connectivity measure was elected is not provided. If this option was elected, no shower-and-changing facilities are shown on floor plans or site plan (39 units GFA < 100,000 sf would require minimum 2 facilities; GFA = 83,986 sf).

details.text: Elevator requirement documentation incomplete. Building with 39 units requires elevator analysis; compliance depends on unit distribution per floor but not documented on plans.

runComments.comment: Multifamily building with 39 units exceeds the 20-unit threshold. Elevator requirement per IBC depends on whether fewer than 25% of units are located on the ground floor. Unit floor distribution by building is not documented on site plan, so compliance cannot be verified.

comments.headline: Project data values inconsistent across documents
comments.summary: Gross floor area, unit count, building coverage, and story count show inconsistencies across the site plan, TIA Determination worksheet, and Water Benchmarking Application, preventing verification of core project parameters.
comments.crossDep: Austin Water (GFA and building coverage reconciliation for Water Benchmarking Application)
comments.attn: Water Benchmarking Application not provided in submitted documents — cannot verify cross-document consistency per LDC § 25-9-413.

details.text: GFA value of 83,986 sf on site data table cannot be verified against Water Benchmarking Application; benchmarking application not provided for comparison.

runComments.comment: Cross-consistency of square footage values across site data table, parking table, TIA worksheet, and Water Benchmarking Application cannot be verified. Site Data Table shows GFA of 83,986 sf, but the benchmarking application is not included in the available documents for comparison. Master comment report (OWB2) indicates pending requirement to ensure GFA consistency with benchmarking application.

Gross Floor Area (GFA) value on site plan sheet (83,986 sf) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application. Austin Water OWB comment OWB2 explicitly requests that GFA be added to site data table and verified consistent with benchmarking application, but the benchmarking application itself is not provided in submitted documents for cross-verification.

details.text: Unit count inconsistency: Site plan shows 39 units (16 Two Bed + 23 Three Bed); TIA Determination Worksheet shows 38 units. Must reconcile.

runComments.comment: Residential unit count is inconsistent across submitted documents. Site plan (Sheet 9, Building Data Table) shows 39 units total (16 Two Bedroom + 23 Three Bedroom). TIA Determination Worksheet (Trip Generation table) shows 38 units. These values must reconcile.

details.text: Building coverage (roof area) value of 32,296 sf on site data table cannot be verified against Water Benchmarking Application; application not provided.

runComments.comment: Building coverage (roof area) value consistency between site plan and Water Benchmarking Application cannot be verified. Site plan shows 32,296 sf building coverage (34% of site), but the benchmarking application is not provided for direct comparison.

Building roof area value from site plan (32,296 sf building coverage per Site Data Table) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application. The benchmarking application is not provided in submitted documents, and Austin Water OWB comment OWB7 indicates pending updates required to this value.

details.text: Story count (maximum 3 documented) cannot be verified against Water Benchmarking Application and project narrative. Application not provided for cross-verification.

runComments.comment: Number of stories (maximum 3 stories documented on site plan) cannot be verified for consistency with the Water Benchmarking Application and project narrative. The benchmarking application document is not provided for cross-verification.

comments.headline: Water Benchmarking Application and conditional designations missing
comments.summary: Water Benchmarking Application with Austin Water director approval is not submitted as required for multifamily projects. Smart Housing or affordable housing unit designations not identified if applicable.
comments.crossDep: Austin Water (Water Benchmarking Application submission and director approval); Affordability Program (Smart Housing enrollment verification if applicable)
comments.attn: Confirm Smart Housing program enrollment status with applicant before finalizing designation requirement.

details.text: Water Benchmarking Application and Austin Water director approval not submitted. 39-unit multifamily with Austin Water retail service requires WBA per LDC § 25-9-413(A). Submit completed application reconciled to site data (GFA 83,986 sf) and document director approval as condition of site plan release.

runComments.comment: Water Benchmarking Application submission and Austin Water director approval documentation are not present in the available site plan documentation. Project is a 39-unit multi-family residential development receiving City of Austin (Austin Water) retail service, making WBA submission a condition of site plan approval per LDC § 25-9-413. Master comment report shows this item is pending (OWB2 status) with requirement to submit and ensure consistency with site data table. Additionally, total GFA is 83,986 sf (below 250,000 SF large development threshold), so pre-release director consultation requirement does not apply. Provide WBA approval documentation from Austin Water director as required condition of site plan release.

Site plan is a multifamily residential project (39 units) with Austin Water retail service, requiring a Water Benchmarking Application as a condition of site plan approval per LDC § 25-9-413. Benchmarking application is confirmed in review with Austin Water (multiple OWB comments pending), but neither the application document nor Austin Water director approval documentation is present on the site plan sheets. GFA (83,986 sf) is below the 250,000 SF large development threshold, so pre-release director consultation is not required, but director approval must be documented.

Water Benchmarking Application submission and Austin Water director approval are not documented. Project is 39 multi-family units (≥5 units) receiving Austin Water retail service, triggering WBA requirement per LDC § 25-9-413(A). Submit completed Water Benchmarking Application with values reconciled to site data table (GFA: 83,986 sf, stories, building coverage), and document Austin Water director approval as a condition of site plan release.

details.text: Smart Housing or income-restricted affordable housing unit designations not identified on site plan or supplementary materials. Applicability cannot be verified without explicit project description.

runComments.comment: No Smart Housing or income-restricted affordable housing unit designations are identified in the site plan documents or supplementary materials. Cannot verify applicability without project description explicitly stating whether Smart Housing or affordable units are proposed.
